main_text.head: IN EPISTOLAM S. IUDAE APOSTOLI PERBREVES NOTAE, ex Prælestionibus Francisci Iunij Biturigis.
main_text.p: AD GENERALEM οἰκονομίαν hujus Epistolæ quam suscepimus exponendam, videntur capita quinque præmitti oportere, & ex ordine explicari.
1. De autore cùm ex inscriptione, tum ex salutatione cognoscimus. Nominatur enim Iudas Apostolus in ipsa inscriptione: in salutatione verò servus Iesu Christi, & Iacobi

page.notes: Greek word οἰκονομίαν printed as "οἰκονομίαν" in heading line, transcribed as printed. Running head absent. The first line of the last paragraph ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page, which is the end of the printed text here. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
